problem: SwiftTerm terminal selection gets cleared during TUI app redraws (e.g., Claude Code 'thinking')
hint: SwiftTerm clears selection in two places: (1) feedPrepare() sets selection.active=false on EVERY data receive, (2) linefeed() calls selection.selectNone() on every linefeed. iTerm2 doesn't have this problem because selection uses absolute buffer coordinates which remain valid even when screen content changes. Fix by commenting out these lines in your local SwiftTerm fork. Key insight from Gemini: iTerm2 stores selection as {Start: (AbsLine: 5042, Col: 5), End: (AbsLine: 5044, Col: 10)} - absolute line numbers that don't change when screen scrolls.
